name: fs-tools
description: External fs consumer: exposes the fs@1 capability as the tools 'fs read', 'fs write', 'fs append', 'fs str_replace', 'fs insert', 'fs apply_patch', 'fs list', 'fs info', 'fs search' and 'fs grep' - provider agnostic, no backend named

config.description: The consumer only shapes the tools it registers; roots, caps and the spill directory belong to the provider's row.

listLimit.description: Default 'limit' of the 'fs list' tool (default 1000, the provider's own cap still applies).
